mechanism_gate: a putative class needs>=5 strict-stable unreproduced rescues in one original label across>=3folds, >=5 retained matched pairs with same label and some sequence/family support, and direct cached endpoint-consistent experimental evidence on BOTH sides. Annotation mentions/name categories alone do not meet direct-evidence gate. If not satisfied, stop mechanism claims and do not propose a new biological module from isolated cases.
guardrails: No known test/external outcomes, no changed true labels, no new NN/student/route, no treating unexplained as causal. Save all cases/harms and matched coverage. Strict residual selection itself uses outcomes and is only offline diagnostic, cannot be deployed to choose samples.
